article.story: New Orleans Pelicans (4-6, 11th in the Western Conference) vs. Golden State Warriors (7-3, fifth in the Western Conference) San Francisco; Monday, 10 p.m. EST LINE: Warriors -9.5; over/under is 231.5 BOTTOM LINE: Golden State hosts the New Orleans Pelicans after Stephen Curry scored 41 points in the Golden State Warriors' 126-119 overtime win against the Orlando Magic. Golden State finished 37-45 overall, 24-28 in Western Conference games and 22-19 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Warriors gave up 115.2 points per game while committing 19.6 fouls last season. New Orleans went 26-56 overall and 17-34 in Western Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Pelicans averaged 25.1 assists per game on 42.1 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Warriors: Will Richard: out (thumb), Moses Moody: out (knee), Kristaps Porzingis: out (illness), Gui Santos: day to day (knee), Jimmy Butler III: out (knee). Pelicans: Yves Missi: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
